label: Bible Study
prompt: The _____ of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.
verse: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.
note: The rebuilt temple looked small next to Solomon's — God promised its glory would be greater.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath _____ thee; go in peace.
verse: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
note: A sinful woman washed Jesus's feet with her tears; He sent her off forgiven, saved, and in peace.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our _____ are gone out.
verse: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
note: The five foolish virgins brought lamps but no extra oil, and the wise ones wouldn't risk sharing theirs.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither _____ nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
verse: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
note: Agur's prayer: not too poor to be tempted to steal, not too rich to forget God — just daily bread.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He _____ not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
verse: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
note: Abraham, about a hundred years old, 'staggered not at the promise' — no wobble, just stronger faith.
